# ============================================================
# RNA-seq Hallmark ssGSEA dotplot for ER+ pILC Bionano/grant subgroup
# Input: log2TPM matrix
# Gene sets: MSigDB Hallmark GMT file
# Analysis: ssGSEA using only selected 10 samples
# Plot: Hallmark pathway summary dotplot and sample-level bubble dotplot similar to example
# Updated sample-level plot: pathway-wise 0-1 scaled ssGSEA color, gene ratio (%) size, Y-axis dendrogram
# ============================================================

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = TRUE)
```

```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

if (!requireNamespace("GSVA", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The GSVA package is required for ssGSEA. Install/load GSVA before running this Rmd.")
}

if (!requireNamespace("ComplexHeatmap", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The ComplexHeatmap package is required to draw the Y-axis dendrogram bubble plot.")
}

if (!requireNamespace("circlize", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("The circlize package is required for the ssGSEA score color scale.")
}

graphics.off()
gc()

# ============================================================
# Paths
# ============================================================

tpm_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/4_Count_file_pILC/Max_TPM/tpm_matrix_pILC_log2TPM.txt"

hallmark_gmt_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/h.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Grant/RNASeq/ssGSEA/Hallmark_n10"
table_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "tables")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# ER+ Bionano / grant subgroup: selected 10 samples only
# ============================================================

grant_samples_10 <- c(
  "TP05-232",
  "TP05-726",
  "TP07-626",
  "TP08-2202",
  "TP11-1516",
  "TP11-1780",
  "TP12-880",
  "TP13-820",
  "TP14-385",
  "TP15-M509"
)

# If TRUE, the script will stop when any of the 10 samples are absent
# from the log2TPM matrix. If FALSE, it will run with available samples
# and report the missing ones.
stop_if_any_sample_missing <- FALSE

# Minimum number of genes from a Hallmark gene set that must be present
# in the TPM matrix.
min_genes_present <- 10

# Number of Hallmark pathways to show in dotplot.
# Use 20 to match the style of the example figure.
top_n_pathways_to_plot <- 20

# Y-axis dendrogram is drawn directly from hierarchical clustering of pathways.
# No cluster numbers or cluster labels are printed on the plot.

# Expression cutoff for sample-level gene ratio (%).
# For log2TPM / log2(TPM + 1), values > 0 correspond to genes with detectable TPM > 0.
expressed_gene_log2TPM_cutoff <- 0

# High-sample definition used for dot size.
# "global_median" means a sample is counted as high for a pathway if its
# ssGSEA score is above the median across all Hallmark pathway-sample scores.
high_definition <- "global_median"

# ============================================================
# Helper functions
# ============================================================

read_gmt_as_list <- function(gmt_file) {
  if (!file.exists(gmt_file)) {
    stop("GMT file does not exist: ", gmt_file)
  }

  gmt_lines <- readLines(gmt_file, warn = FALSE)
  gmt_lines <- gmt_lines[nchar(trimws(gmt_lines)) > 0]

  gene_sets <- lapply(gmt_lines, function(x) {
    parts <- strsplit(x, "\t")[[1]]
    genes <- parts[-c(1, 2)]
    genes <- unique(trimws(genes))
    genes <- genes[!is.na(genes) & genes != ""]
    genes
  })

  gene_set_names <- vapply(gmt_lines, function(x) strsplit(x, "\t")[[1]][1], character(1))
  names(gene_sets) <- gene_set_names

  gene_sets
}

clean_hallmark_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", x)
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  x
}

zscore_rows <- function(mat) {
  z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
  z[is.na(z)] <- 0
  z[z > 2.5] <- 2.5
  z[z < -2.5] <- -2.5
  z
}

run_ssgsea_compatible <- function(expr_mat, gene_sets) {

  # expr_mat: genes x samples numeric matrix, log2TPM values
  # gene_sets: named list of gene symbols

  if ("ssgseaParam" %in% getNamespaceExports("GSVA")) {

    cat("Running ssGSEA using modern GSVA parameter interface...\n")

    param <- GSVA::ssgseaParam(
      exprData = expr_mat,
      geneSets = gene_sets,
      minSize = min_genes_present,
      maxSize = Inf,
      alpha = 0.25,
      normalize = TRUE
    )

    score_mat <- GSVA::gsva(
      param,
      verbose = TRUE
    )

  } else {

    cat("Running ssGSEA using classic GSVA interface...\n")

    score_mat <- GSVA::gsva(
      expr = expr_mat,
      gset.idx.list = gene_sets,
      method = "ssgsea",
      kcdf = "Gaussian",
      abs.ranking = FALSE,
      min.sz = min_genes_present,
      max.sz = Inf,
      ssgsea.norm = TRUE,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  }

  score_mat <- as.matrix(score_mat)
  return(score_mat)
}

# ============================================================
# Read RNA-seq log2TPM matrix
# ============================================================

cat("Reading TPM matrix:\n", tpm_file, "\n\n")

tpm_dt <- fread(
  tpm_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

if (!"Gene" %in% colnames(tpm_dt)) {
  stop("Input TPM matrix must contain a column named 'Gene'.")
}

tpm_dt[, Gene := trimws(as.character(Gene))]

sample_cols_all <- setdiff(colnames(tpm_dt), "Gene")

for (cc in sample_cols_all) {
  tpm_dt[, (cc) := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(get(cc)))]
}

# If duplicate gene symbols exist, keep mean expression per gene.
tpm_dt <- tpm_dt[
  !is.na(Gene) & Gene != "",
  lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = Gene,
  .SDcols = sample_cols_all
]

for (cc in sample_cols_all) {
  tpm_dt[!is.finite(get(cc)), (cc) := NA_real_]
}

# ============================================================
# Identify RNA-seq available selected samples
# ============================================================

rna_available_samples <- grant_samples_10[
  grant_samples_10 %in% colnames(tpm_dt)
]

rna_missing_samples <- setdiff(grant_samples_10, rna_available_samples)

cat("========== RNA-seq availability in selected 10 samples ==========\n")
cat("Requested samples:", length(grant_samples_10), "\n")
cat("RNA-seq available:", length(rna_available_samples), "\n")
cat("RNA-seq missing:", length(rna_missing_samples), "\n\n")

cat("RNA-seq available samples:\n")
print(rna_available_samples)

cat("\nRNA-seq missing samples:\n")
print(rna_missing_samples)

if (stop_if_any_sample_missing && length(rna_missing_samples) > 0) {
  stop("Some selected samples are missing from the log2TPM matrix. See printed missing samples.")
}

if (length(rna_available_samples) < 2) {
  stop("Fewer than 2 selected samples are available in the log2TPM matrix.")
}

rna_availability <- data.table(
  Sample = grant_samples_10,
  RNAseq_available = grant_samples_10 %in% rna_available_samples
)

fwrite(
  rna_availability,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_RNAseq_sample_availability.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Build expression matrix for ssGSEA: genes x selected samples only
# ============================================================

expr_dt <- tpm_dt[
  ,
  c("Gene", rna_available_samples),
  with = FALSE
]

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_dt[, ..rna_available_samples])
rownames(expr_mat) <- expr_dt$Gene

expr_mat[is.na(expr_mat)] <- 0
expr_mat[!is.finite(expr_mat)] <- 0
expr_mat <- expr_mat[!is.na(rownames(expr_mat)) & rownames(expr_mat) != "", , drop = FALSE]

cat("\nExpression matrix used for ssGSEA:\n")
print(dim(expr_mat))

fwrite(
  data.table(Gene = rownames(expr_mat), expr_mat),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_log2TPM_matrix_used_for_Hallmark_ssGSEA.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ============================================================
# Read Hallmark GMT gene sets
# ============================================================

cat("\nReading Hallmark GMT file:\n", hallmark_gmt_file, "\n\n")

hallmark_gene_sets <- read_gmt_as_list(hallmark_gmt_file)

cat("Number of Hallmark gene sets in GMT:", length(hallmark_gene_sets), "\n")

hallmark_gene_sets_present <- lapply(
  hallmark_gene_sets,
  function(gs) intersect(gs, rownames(expr_mat))
)

hallmark_presence_dt <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(hallmark_gene_sets), function(nm) {
    data.table(
      Pathway = nm,
      Pathway_clean = clean_hallmark_name(nm),
      Original_gene_count = length(hallmark_gene_sets[[nm]]),
      Present_gene_count = length(hallmark_gene_sets_present[[nm]]),
      Missing_gene_count = length(setdiff(hallmark_gene_sets[[nm]], rownames(expr_mat))),
      Present_genes = paste(hallmark_gene_sets_present[[nm]], collapse = ";"),
      Missing_genes = paste(setdiff(hallmark_gene_sets[[nm]], rownames(expr_mat)), collapse = ";")
    )
  }),
  fill = TRUE
)

fwrite(
  hallmark_presence_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_gene_presence.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

cat("\n========== Hallmark gene set overlap summary ==========\n")
print(hallmark_presence_dt[, .(Pathway, Original_gene_count, Present_gene_count, Missing_gene_count)])

hallmark_gene_sets_for_ssgsea <- hallmark_gene_sets_present[
  lengths(hallmark_gene_sets_present) >= min_genes_present
]

if (length(hallmark_gene_sets_for_ssgsea) == 0) {
  stop("No Hallmark gene sets passed min_genes_present. Lower min_genes_present or check gene symbols.")
}

cat("\nHallmark pathways used for ssGSEA:", length(hallmark_gene_sets_for_ssgsea), "\n")

# ============================================================
# Run ssGSEA
# ============================================================

ssgsea_score_mat <- run_ssgsea_compatible(
  expr_mat = expr_mat,
  gene_sets = hallmark_gene_sets_for_ssgsea
)

ssgsea_score_mat <- ssgsea_score_mat[, rna_available_samples, drop = FALSE]

# Row Z-score is not used for the dotplot but is useful for a heatmap later.
ssgsea_score_z <- zscore_rows(ssgsea_score_mat)

fwrite(
  data.table(Pathway = rownames(ssgsea_score_mat), ssgsea_score_mat),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_raw_scores.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

fwrite(
  data.table(Pathway = rownames(ssgsea_score_z), ssgsea_score_z),
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_rowZ_scores.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

cat("\nHallmark ssGSEA score matrix dimensions:\n")
print(dim(ssgsea_score_mat))

# ============================================================
# Summarize Hallmark pathway activity for dotplot
# ============================================================

ssgsea_long_dt <- as.data.table(ssgsea_score_mat, keep.rownames = "Pathway") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Pathway,
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "ssGSEA_score"
  ) |>
  as.data.table()

ssgsea_long_dt[, Pathway_clean := clean_hallmark_name(Pathway)]

if (high_definition == "global_median") {
  high_cutoff <- median(ssgsea_long_dt$ssGSEA_score, na.rm = TRUE)
  high_label <- paste0("High cutoff = global median ssGSEA score (", signif(high_cutoff, 3), ")")
} else {
  stop("Unsupported high_definition. Currently supported: global_median")
}

pathway_summary_dt <- ssgsea_long_dt[
  ,
  .(
    Median_score = median(ssGSEA_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_score = mean(ssGSEA_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_score = min(ssGSEA_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max_score = max(ssGSEA_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    Samples_high_n = sum(ssGSEA_score > high_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
    Samples_tested_n = sum(!is.na(ssGSEA_score)),
    Samples_high_percent = 100 * mean(ssGSEA_score > high_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(Pathway, Pathway_clean)
]

setorder(pathway_summary_dt, -Median_score)

fwrite(
  pathway_summary_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_pathway_summary_for_dotplot.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

plot_dt <- pathway_summary_dt[1:min(top_n_pathways_to_plot, .N)]
plot_dt[, Pathway_clean := factor(Pathway_clean, levels = rev(Pathway_clean))]

cat("\nTop pathways selected for dotplot:\n")
print(plot_dt[, .(Pathway_clean, Median_score, Samples_high_percent)])

# ============================================================
# Hallmark ssGSEA dotplot
# ============================================================

p_dot <- ggplot(
  plot_dt,
  aes(
    x = Median_score,
    y = Pathway_clean,
    size = Samples_high_percent,
    color = Median_score
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 11,
    breaks = c(25, 50, 75, 100),
    limits = c(0, 100),
    name = "Samples high (%)"
  ) +
  scale_color_gradient(
    low = "#17324D",
    high = "#67B7F7",
    name = "Median score"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Hallmark ssGSEA pathway activity across pILC samples"),
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Selected RNA-seq/Bionano grant samples: n = ", length(rna_available_samples),
      " | Top ", nrow(plot_dt), " pathways by median ssGSEA score"
    ),
    x = "Median ssGSEA score",
    y = "Hallmark pathway",
    caption = high_label
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey25"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey94", linewidth = 0.25),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30", hjust = 0)
  )

pdf_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_dotplot_top20_median_score.pdf"
)

png_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_dotplot_top20_median_score.png"
)

ggsave(
  filename = pdf_file,
  plot = p_dot,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 8.5,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = png_file,
  plot = p_dot,
  width = 11.5,
  height = 8.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

cat("\nSaved Hallmark ssGSEA dotplot:\n")
cat(pdf_file, "\n")
cat(png_file, "\n")

cat("\nSaved Hallmark ssGSEA tables:\n")
cat(file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_raw_scores.tsv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_rowZ_scores.tsv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_gene_presence.tsv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_pathway_summary_for_dotplot.tsv"), "\n")


# ============================================================
# Sample-level Hallmark ssGSEA bubble plot
# Similar to GSEA per-cell-type bubble plot style
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Each dot = one sample-pathway pair
# X-axis   = selected pILC sample
# Y-axis   = Hallmark pathway ordered by hierarchical clustering
# Color    = pathway-wise 0-1 scaled ssGSEA score
# Size     = gene ratio (%)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Important:
# In classical GSEA/GO plots, Gene Ratio often refers to enriched or leading-edge
# genes. For ssGSEA, there is no direct leading-edge gene ratio from the score.
# Here Gene Ratio (%) is defined as:
#     expressed Hallmark genes in that sample / Hallmark genes present in matrix x 100
# where expressed means log2TPM > expressed_gene_log2TPM_cutoff.
# ============================================================

# Use the same top pathways selected by median ssGSEA score in the summary plot.
top_pathways_for_sample_plot <- as.character(plot_dt$Pathway)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Calculate sample-level gene ratio (%) for each pathway-sample pair
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gene_ratio_dt <- rbindlist(
  lapply(names(hallmark_gene_sets_for_ssgsea), function(pw) {

    genes_present <- intersect(hallmark_gene_sets_for_ssgsea[[pw]], rownames(expr_mat))

    rbindlist(
      lapply(rna_available_samples, function(ss) {

        if (length(genes_present) == 0) {
          return(data.table(
            Pathway = pw,
            Sample = ss,
            Pathway_present_gene_count = 0L,
            Expressed_gene_count = 0L,
            Gene_ratio_percent = NA_real_
          ))
        }

        vals <- expr_mat[genes_present, ss]
        expressed_n <- sum(vals > expressed_gene_log2TPM_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)

        data.table(
          Pathway = pw,
          Sample = ss,
          Pathway_present_gene_count = length(genes_present),
          Expressed_gene_count = expressed_n,
          Gene_ratio_percent = 100 * expressed_n / length(genes_present)
        )
      }),
      fill = TRUE
    )
  }),
  fill = TRUE
)

fwrite(
  gene_ratio_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_sample_level_gene_ratio.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine raw ssGSEA score with gene ratio (%)
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sample_bubble_dt <- merge(
  ssgsea_long_dt,
  gene_ratio_dt,
  by = c("Pathway", "Sample"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

sample_bubble_dt[, Pathway_clean := clean_hallmark_name(Pathway)]

sample_bubble_plot_dt <- sample_bubble_dt[
  Pathway %in% top_pathways_for_sample_plot
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Hierarchical clustering of pathways on Y-axis
# Draw dendrogram only; no cluster labels / no Cluster 1/2/3 panels.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

top_pathway_score_mat <- ssgsea_score_mat[
  top_pathways_for_sample_plot,
  rna_available_samples,
  drop = FALSE
]

top_pathway_score_mat[!is.finite(top_pathway_score_mat)] <- 0

if (nrow(top_pathway_score_mat) >= 2) {

  pathway_hclust <- hclust(
    dist(top_pathway_score_mat, method = "euclidean"),
    method = "complete"
  )

  clustered_pathway_order <- pathway_hclust$labels[pathway_hclust$order]

} else {

  pathway_hclust <- FALSE
  clustered_pathway_order <- rownames(top_pathway_score_mat)
}

pathway_order_dt <- data.table(
  Pathway = clustered_pathway_order,
  Dendrogram_order = seq_along(clustered_pathway_order)
)
pathway_order_dt[, Pathway_clean := clean_hallmark_name(Pathway)]

# Merge only the dendrogram order to avoid duplicate Pathway_clean.x / Pathway_clean.y columns.
sample_bubble_plot_dt <- merge(
  sample_bubble_plot_dt,
  pathway_order_dt[, .(Pathway, Dendrogram_order)],
  by = "Pathway",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Ensure one clean pathway-label column is present after merge.
sample_bubble_plot_dt[, Pathway_clean := clean_hallmark_name(Pathway)]

# Keep sample order exactly as requested/available.
sample_bubble_plot_dt[, Sample := factor(Sample, levels = rna_available_samples)]

fwrite(
  sample_bubble_plot_dt,
  file = file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_sample_pathway_bubble_top20_rawScore_geneRatio_dendrogramY_plot_data.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)

cat("\nSample-level bubble plot data preview:\n")
print(
  sample_bubble_plot_dt[
    order(Dendrogram_order, Sample),
    .(
      Dendrogram_order,
      Pathway_clean,
      Sample,
      ssGSEA_score,
      Gene_ratio_percent,
      Expressed_gene_count,
      Pathway_present_gene_count
    )
  ][1:min(.N, 20)]
)

cat("\nPathway order from Y-axis dendrogram:\n")
print(pathway_order_dt)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Convert data to matrices for ComplexHeatmap bubble plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

score_mat_for_plot <- top_pathway_score_mat[
  top_pathways_for_sample_plot,
  rna_available_samples,
  drop = FALSE
]

score_mat_for_plot[!is.finite(score_mat_for_plot)] <- NA_real_

# Matrix of gene ratio (%) with the same row/column structure as ssGSEA score matrix.
gene_ratio_wide <- dcast(
  sample_bubble_plot_dt,
  Pathway ~ Sample,
  value.var = "Gene_ratio_percent"
)

gene_ratio_mat <- as.matrix(gene_ratio_wide[, ..rna_available_samples])
rownames(gene_ratio_mat) <- gene_ratio_wide$Pathway

gene_ratio_mat <- gene_ratio_mat[
  rownames(score_mat_for_plot),
  colnames(score_mat_for_plot),
  drop = FALSE
]

gene_ratio_mat[!is.finite(gene_ratio_mat)] <- NA_real_

# Row labels should be clean Hallmark names but the internal rownames remain full pathway IDs.
row_labels <- clean_hallmark_name(rownames(score_mat_for_plot))
names(row_labels) <- rownames(score_mat_for_plot)

# Pathway-wise min-max scaling (0 to 1) for color only.
# Raw ssGSEA scores are still preserved in the output tables.
score_scaled_mat_for_plot <- t(apply(score_mat_for_plot, 1, function(x) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  finite_x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(finite_x) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }

  x_min <- min(finite_x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(finite_x, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(x_min) || !is.finite(x_max)) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }

  if (x_max == x_min) {
    return(rep(0.5, length(x)))
  }

  (x - x_min) / (x_max - x_min)
}))

rownames(score_scaled_mat_for_plot) <- rownames(score_mat_for_plot)
colnames(score_scaled_mat_for_plot) <- colnames(score_mat_for_plot)

scaled_vals <- as.numeric(score_scaled_mat_for_plot)
scaled_vals <- scaled_vals[is.finite(scaled_vals)]

if (length(scaled_vals) == 0) {
  stop("No finite scaled ssGSEA scores available for plotting.")
}

score_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(0, 0.5, 1),
  c("#D9D9D9", "#7A5195", "#E31A1C")
)

max_dot_radius_mm <- 3.4

# Bubble-size legend for Gene Ratio (%).
gene_ratio_legend <- ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
  title = "Gene Ratio (%)",
  labels = c("25", "50", "75", "100"),
  type = "points",
  pch = 16,
  size = grid::unit(sqrt(c(25, 50, 75, 100) / 100) * max_dot_radius_mm * 2, "mm"),
  legend_gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", fill = "black"),
  title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
  labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
)

# Custom legend for scaled ssGSEA score so it appears together with the Gene Ratio legend.
score_legend <- ComplexHeatmap::Legend(
  title = "Scaled ssGSEA\nscore",
  col_fun = score_col_fun,
  at = c(0, 0.5, 1),
  labels = c("0", "0.5", "1"),
  title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
  labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9),
  legend_height = grid::unit(28, "mm")
)

combined_legend <- ComplexHeatmap::packLegend(
  gene_ratio_legend,
  score_legend,
  direction = "vertical",
  gap = grid::unit(2, "mm")
)
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot: raw ssGSEA score + gene ratio (%) + Y-axis dendrogram
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
  score_mat_for_plot,
  name = "Scaled ssGSEA score",
  col = score_col_fun,
  cluster_rows = pathway_hclust,
  row_dend_side = "left",
  show_row_dend = TRUE,
  row_dend_width = grid::unit(18, "mm"),
  row_dend_reorder = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  width = grid::unit(ncol(score_mat_for_plot) * 5.5, "mm"),
  row_labels = row_labels,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9.5, col = "black"),
  column_names_rot = 45,
  column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10.5, col = "black"),
  column_title = paste0(
    "Hallmark ssGSEA pathway activity per pILC sample\n",
    "Selected RNA-seq/Bionano grant samples: n = ", length(rna_available_samples),
    " | Top ", length(top_pathways_for_sample_plot),
    " pathways by median ssGSEA score"
  ),
  column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold"),
  rect_gp = grid::gpar(type = "none"),
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Scaled ssGSEA score",
    title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
    labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
  ),
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {

    # Light cell boundary, similar to the reference dotplot style.
    grid::grid.rect(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = "grey90", lwd = 0.5)
    )

    score_value <- score_mat_for_plot[i, j]
    score_scaled_value <- score_scaled_mat_for_plot[i, j]
    gene_ratio_value <- gene_ratio_mat[i, j]

    if (is.finite(score_scaled_value) && is.finite(gene_ratio_value) && gene_ratio_value > 0) {

      radius_mm <- sqrt(gene_ratio_value / 100) * max_dot_radius_mm

      grid::grid.circle(
        x = x,
        y = y,
        r = grid::unit(radius_mm, "mm"),
        gp = grid::gpar(
          fill = score_col_fun(score_scaled_value),
          col = NA,
          alpha = 0.95
        )
      )
    }
  }
)

sample_bubble_pdf_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_sample_pathway_bubble_top20_scaledColor_geneRatio_dendrogramY_noSampleNames_legendFIX.pdf"
)

sample_bubble_png_file <- file.path(
  plot_dir,
  "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_sample_pathway_bubble_top20_scaledColor_geneRatio_dendrogramY_noSampleNames_legendFIX.png"
)

caption_text <- paste0(
  "Each dot represents one sample-pathway pair. Dot color = pathway-wise min-max scaled ssGSEA score (0 to 1). ",
  "Dot size = Gene Ratio (%), defined as expressed pathway genes / pathway genes present in the expression matrix x 100; ",
  "expressed = log2TPM > ", expressed_gene_log2TPM_cutoff, ". ",
  "Rows are ordered by hierarchical clustering of raw ssGSEA score patterns. Sample names are hidden for a cleaner plot."
)

pdf(sample_bubble_pdf_file, width = 13.5, height = 9.0)
grid::grid.newpage()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_list = list(gene_ratio_legend),
  merge_legends = TRUE,
  padding = grid::unit(c(8, 8, 18, 4), "mm")
)
grid::grid.text(
  caption_text,
  x = grid::unit(8, "mm"),
  y = grid::unit(5, "mm"),
  just = c("left", "bottom"),
  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7.5, col = "grey30")
)
dev.off()

png(sample_bubble_png_file, width = 13.5, height = 9.0, units = "in", res = 300)
grid::grid.newpage()
ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_list = list(gene_ratio_legend),
  merge_legends = TRUE,
  padding = grid::unit(c(8, 8, 18, 4), "mm")
)
grid::grid.text(
  caption_text,
  x = grid::unit(8, "mm"),
  y = grid::unit(5, "mm"),
  just = c("left", "bottom"),
  gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7.5, col = "grey30")
)
dev.off()

cat("\nSaved sample-level Hallmark ssGSEA bubble plot with pathway-wise scaled color, gene ratio, and Y-axis dendrogram:\n")
cat(sample_bubble_pdf_file, "\n")
cat(sample_bubble_png_file, "\n")

cat("\nSaved sample-level bubble plot data table:\n")
cat(file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_sample_pathway_bubble_top20_rawScore_geneRatio_dendrogramY_plot_data.tsv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(table_dir, "Bionano_grant_n10_Hallmark_ssGSEA_sample_level_gene_ratio.tsv"), "\n")
```
